business_problem: JULO needed a cost-effective and always-on cloud architecture for a regulated Indonesian fintech business that processes large volumes of data and cannot tolerate downtime while serving lending and payment products.
solution_summary: JULO standardized its fintech infrastructure on a broad Alibaba Cloud footprint spanning compute, network, storage, database, container, and serverless services. Elastic Compute Service is the core runtime for production applications and internal services, while built-in snapshots and Auto Scaling reduce manual operations and let the platform respond to changing demand. Server Load Balancer acts as the entry point with failover and health checks that support the high-availability architecture required for OJK-aligned operations. The environment is extended with Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) and Function Compute so JULO can mix containerized and serverless delivery models, while ApsaraDB RDS provides managed relational data services for the business. This architecture gives the lender a more robust and programmable base for core products such as Dana Tunai, Paylater, and Tagihan Online, while preserving budget discipline and preparing the company to add more security and big-data services as demand grows.
business_outcome: JULO built a stronger and more reliable fintech platform that supports regulatory compliance, 24/7 service availability, and continued product growth in the Indonesian market.

solution_components.name: Auto Scaling

solution_components.name: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK)
solution_components.role: Hosts containerized fintech workloads as part of the broader application platform.

solution_components.name: Function Compute
solution_components.role: Adds serverless execution for supporting application functions.

data_flow: Customer requests arrive through Server Load Balancer, execute on ECS, ACK, and Function Compute services, persist transactional state in ApsaraDB RDS, and scale automatically through snapshots and Auto Scaling as demand changes.
